purpose: Teach: 於け/探訪/無実/乞う/絶た/幾多/慶応/変調

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、契約条項に於ける責任範囲を弁護士に確認させろ
lines.en: Have the lawyers verify our liability scope in the contract terms.
lines.style: Authoritative, clipped delivery. Each clause lands with weight. No room for misinterpretation. Steady eye contact, posture upright. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場現場の探訪記事を社内報に載せます
lines.en: Understood. I'll get that factory site article into the company newsletter.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Leans slightly forward, listening beneath the task. Voice level and assured — not obsequious, but clearly taking the directive seriously. A nod in the shoulders.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、品質クレームに対し無実なら、誠実に説明しろ
lines.en: If we're blameless on these quality complaints, explain it clearly and with integrity.
lines.style: Firm, measured cadence. Emphasizes 'blameless' and 'integrity' with quiet conviction — not angry, but uncompromising. Slight pause before the second clause. The voice of someone who believes honesty is strategy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取引先からの早期納品を乞う声に応えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll respond to the clients asking for earlier delivery timelines.
lines.style: Calm, efficient. Takes the instruction without elaboration. Voice steady and capable — the tone of someone who translates directives into action without fanfare. Slight nod of acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、サプライチェーンが絶たれない様、リスク管理を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our risk management so the supply chain never breaks.
lines.style: Direct, almost grave. The word 'never' carries weight. Slower pace on the critical phrase. Breath controlled. This is not suggestion — it's imperative. Lean back slightly, eyes steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。幾多の経済危機を乗り越えた経験を活かします
lines.en: Understood. I'll draw on the experience we've gained surviving past economic crises.
lines.style: Composed, almost reflective. Slight lift on 'experience' — a quiet confidence in what's been weathered. Even tone, unhurried. The voice of someone who sees a pattern and trusts it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、慶応大学の経済学者を顧問に招け
lines.en: Bring in an economist from Keio University as an advisor.
lines.style: Sharp, decisive. Minimal warmth. The instruction is specific and expects execution. Clipped at the end. Posture doesn't invite discussion — this is decided. A brief glance, then attention moving forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の急な変調にも素早く対応します
lines.en: Understood. We're prepared to pivot quickly when market conditions shift unexpectedly.
lines.style: Quiet confidence, almost understated. Doesn't oversell readiness — states it as fact. Steady breathing, even pace. A slight sense of closure in the voice, like a conversation reaching its conclusion. Professional but not stiff.
